kernel_semantics.geometry: 2D only, common preprocess after wrapper check_nD; non2D/empty checked before Cython
kernel_semantics.percentile: No interpolation. CDF strictly greater than p0*population, except p0==1 selects highest occupied bin.
kernel_semantics.threshold_percentile: CDF greater-or-equal; p0==0 selects bin0 even with zero histogram count there. Output is (capacity-1)*(center>=selected), not0/1.
kernel_semantics.autolevel_percentile: Low ascending and high descending strictCDF > targets p0*pop and (1-p1)*pop. Clamp center then signed integer quotient before any output cast; nonpositive delta returns high-low.
kernel_semantics.gradient_percentile: CDF >= targets while scanning ALL bins including empty bins; default endpoints can yield capacity-1 rather than occupied range.
kernel_semantics.enhance_contrast_percentile: Strict endpoint scans; final nearest endpoint wins, ties lower. Earlier clipping stores are overwritten by final branch.
kernel_semantics.mean_pop_sum_subtract: Include an entire bin iff cumulative population AFTER bin is inclusively between p0*pop and p1*pop. No fractional bin weights. Sum/count integer arithmetic; mean signed integer quotient.
kernel_semantics.subtract_mean_percentile: (center-integer_mean)*0.5+floor(capacity/2), without the ordinary subtract_mean -1. Selected-count0 or population0 writes0.
kernel_semantics.output: u8/u16/f32/f64 fused types plus actual error observations. Integral stores of integer values wrap; floating-to-unsigned only source-qualified representable truncation domains included.
kernel_semantics.parameter_order: Raw per-runtime FloatEvent traces preserve p0/p1 conversion order and early buffer/shift/footprint failures, without guessing Cython dispatcher internals.

safety.workspace_bound: Each of eight signed-index border arrays <=289*8 bytes; histogram <=524288bytes; typed sums fit int64.
safety.zero_population: All nine source kernels have explicit population-zero store0; safe empty windows included.
safety.included_parameter_domain: Only real finite 0<=p0<=p1<=1 reaches kernels (single-parameter funcs ignore the p1 concept); exact conversion errors and bounded NumPy scalar/size1 providers included.
exclusions: undersized mask or spatial output, actual zero channel depth
nonfinite percentile values, out-of-range or unordered percentile intervals
impractically large allocations and signed-index/sum overflow domains
arbitrary array/shape/copy hooks, concurrent mutations, memmap I/O lifecycle
exhaustive dtype extensions beyond twelve real dtypes and explicit rejected examples

future_interface_proposal.geometry: RankView singleton plane only; existing byte spatial output strides
future_interface_proposal.entry: separate percentile entry taking prepared RankView, operation, finite qualified p0/p1 doubles; all metadata/conversion-order stages explicit
future_interface_proposal.aliases: Canonical funcs identical to private _percentile funcs; do not invent public nested module or additional algorithm count
future_interface_proposal.workers: Reuse sole shared optional global worker limit, default1; independent row windows deterministic; future public/native proof required
